rawSources.locator: Nintendo History L173-L175: Game Boy was the first portable handheld game system with interchangeable game cartridges and was introduced in Japan in 1989. L179 states Game Boy launched in Europe in 1990.

literalGroups.primaryGround: Nintendo primary history L173-L175 says Game Boy was introduced in Japan in 1989 and was the first portable handheld game system with interchangeable cartridges. It supports year and keyed distinction; the broad competing-device claims are not established by this passage, so unique-key support remains incomplete.

literalGroups.literal: Game Boy был компактной портативной системой со сменными игровыми картриджами. Играть можно было вдали от домашнего телевизора.
literalGroups.primaryGround: L173-L175 supports the Game Boy portable handheld classification and Japanese introduction in 1989. It does not say that players could play away from a home television; that consequence is plausible inference, not the cited passage.
